messages:
Eli: Quick shoutout to Noa and Jun for rescuing the office plant and grabbing sushi for the backlog crunch team. absolute legends. :seedling: :sushi:

Noa: Ha, thanks! Jun spotted the droopy leaves and I grabbed water + food on the way home. Team snack > stress.

Jun: also left a tiny note on the plant pot: 'We believe in you' lol.

Eli: can we drop a 30s kudos at stand? Feels small but deserves mention.

Noa: yes please. Also stickers? people-ops said small tokens are okay.

people-ops: Confirmed — we can reimburse up to $25/team for thank-you treats. Submit expense with note "plant + snack kudos". :white_check_mark:

kudos-bot: Automated: Noa and Jun received 8 kudos reactions and 3 emoji hearts in the last 12h. Recommended reward: 'Plant Hero' stickers.

Eli: Perfect. I'll add a 1-line shoutout to tomorrow's standup and post the sticker pack link. Thanks y'all :)
